entry_item.definition: v. t. a) To break apart; to tear asunder; to cut off; to separate. b) To sever ; to discontinue, stop; to interrupt; to put an end to; to uproot; to decide ( a matter or case).

example.definition: To tear or pull a rope apart.
To make a decision; to try or decide in court; pronounce sentence.
To put an end to or to take somebody's life.
To interrupt a talk or conversation
To put an end to sufferings.
To discontinue the giving of alms.
To cut off the road or communication (also fig.).

entry_item.definition: briser, rompre , rompre en plusieurs morceaux, interrompre, couper, séparer: 2 fig. finir, mettre fin, couper le cours d'une affaire.

example.definition: cesse les relations avec les amis, les parents!

entry_item.definition: v.t. To destroy. To cut or pull in two. To bite. To tear in pieces. To solve.

example.definition: n. The joining of a rope, that has been broken.
